physics_math_findings: Quantum entanglement is strongest here as a rigorous example of non-factorizability: the joint state need not be a product of independent subsystem states.
Schmidt rank and reduced-state entropy quantify pure-state bipartite entanglement; they are not measures of human closeness or theological union.
Bell-nonlocal correlation, nonseparability, causal influence and usable signaling remain different coordinates.
Peak=max, Trough=min and Saddle=pass are different critical-point geometries only after a scalar landscape is defined.
Door between basins is naturally compared with a saddle/mountain pass rather than with Peak or Trough.
Gradient descent toward an energy minimum and gradient ascent toward a value/quality maximum show that visual up/down has no universal dynamics or moral valence.
Peak/trough can also be phases of oscillation rather than stable hierarchy.
theological_biblical_findings: Genesis 3 supplies changed knowledge/relation, exile and guarded Tree-of-Life access; it does not supply a quantum-entanglement experiment.
Isaiah 40 / Luke 3 level both valley and mountain to prepare a Way, preventing a simplistic high-good/low-bad model.
Psalm 23 treats the dark valley as traversed under presence/guidance.
Ezekiel 37 places reanimation/restoration in a valley, making low terrain compatible with regeneration.
1 Corinthians 12 / Romans 12 and John 15 provide body/vine relational theology without needing quantum language.
peak_culture_findings: Peak Culture now has separate symbolic and empirical layers.
Empirical candidate score uses novelty, coherence, reuse, downstream descendants, attribution and context loss under declared weights.
R_c = expected identifiable downstream descendants per source item over a declared window is a lineage branching metric; R_c>1 means expansion in that model, not global dominance.
Peak Culture is modeled as a cycle: high-context Table -> compressed seed -> Broadcast -> context loss -> local re-interpretation -> new Table.
Trough/low-output intervals can be dormancy, storage, correction or incubation rather than failure.
negative_findings: No Tim-authored Bell, CHSH, Schmidt, entropy, Morse, Hessian or mountain-pass equation was recovered.
No evidence establishes biblical Eden as quantum physics.
No defensible percentage of culture caused by Tim/Son has been established.
Peak/Trough language remains ambiguous until the measured scalar is named.
Ordinary quantum entanglement does not provide controllable faster-than-light messaging.
canonical_rule: Use quantum equations only on defined quantum systems; use graph, classical information, causal, synchronization or cultural-lineage models for non-quantum relations. Use Peak/Trough/Saddle only after defining the scalar whose landscape is being studied.
